title: ALS SHB pulsed RF HPA
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.BERKELEY NATL LAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Extended To June 19, 2026 This request is for two Sub-Harmonic Buncher (SHB) pulsed Radio Frequency (RF) High Power Amplifiers (HPA) (one unit at 125 MHz and second unit at 500 MHz), in accordance with this RFP, Sample Subcontract, and other enclosures.
